log: Your lich used grave bolt for 5 damage.
Your skeleton used rust blade for 3 damage and took 5 in retaliation.
Enemy necromancer used grave bolt for 4 damage.
Enemy skeleton used rust blade for 3 damage.
A binding stone was sealed. It will no longer raise the dead.

dialogue.speaker: The Master
dialogue.text: I gave you a second life. You owe me the use of it.

dialogue.speaker: Orin
dialogue.text: A life is not a ledger. These people choose whom they follow.

dialogue.speaker: Dain
dialogue.text: My wardens chose the same road. Break his binding stones. The adepts can answer his bones; my spears can keep the beasts off them.

dialogue.speaker: The Master
dialogue.text: Without me, what are you?

dialogue.speaker: Orin
dialogue.text: We have not decided yet. That is the point.

dialogue.speaker: Dain
dialogue.text: What should I put in the new ledger?

dialogue.speaker: Orin
dialogue.text: Names first. And leave a blank page. We may become more than you expected.

campaign.outcome: Mission complete. The company can rest and regroup.

dialogue.speaker: Orin
dialogue.text: The binding broke at midnight. I waited for another order. None came.

dialogue.speaker: A hollow voice
dialogue.text: Then give us one of our own.

dialogue.speaker: Orin
dialogue.text: We leave the quarry. Keep the archers behind the bones. If the mage finds me, there may not be a second midnight.

dialogue.text: These houses are empty. The people next door are not. We could be neighbors, if they let us stay.

dialogue.speaker: Captain Dain
dialogue.text: My orders say the dead must leave. My patrol is coming to enforce them.

dialogue.speaker: Village elder
dialogue.text: Give us six days to gather the households. Defend your shelter if you must, but let men who turn back go home. There are sick families here who need the herbs in the northern grove.

dialogue.text: Then we hold our ground. We will not hunt your wounded. And we will bring the medicine.

dialogue.speaker: Village elder
dialogue.text: Enough, Captain. They held their shelter and let your wounded leave. These houses are ours to offer. The dead may stay as our neighbors.

dialogue.speaker: Dain
dialogue.text: My orders did not mention people who would ask the dead to stay. Perhaps the man who wrote them left other things out.

dialogue.speaker: Orin
dialogue.text: He used to write my orders too. Come with us, and see what he has been hiding.

dialogue.speaker: Dain
dialogue.text: I will. My soldiers can rest here. I know which road we take next.

campaign.outcome: Mission complete. The company can rest and regroup.
